name: Jio Financial Services Ltd.
business_summary: Holding company (RBI-registered NBFC-ND-SI) demerged from Reliance in 2023, building a consumer-facing financial supermarket: Jio Credit/Jio Finance (lending; AUM >Rs 30,000 cr in Q1 FY27), JioBlackRock Asset Management (50:50 with BlackRock), Jio Payments Solutions, Jio Insurance Broking, a 50% stake in Jio Payments Bank and an insurance venture with Allianz. In August 2026 Bank of America agreed to buy up to 49.9% of Jio Credit for Rs 18,268 cr. Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 340 cr (-51% y/y) on higher funding and operating costs; stock P/E 92, P/B 1.16.

cost_structure.note: interest Rs 578 cr of ~Rs1,166 cr total Q2 expenses

exposures.mechanism: Early-stage lender (Jio Credit AUM >Rs30k cr, Q1 FY27); revenue Rs 5.6k cr TTM +123%. +3pp system credit growth eases funding/demand; scale-up thesis: +10% AUM -> NII +10% on operating leverage; w ~+2.5 (small system beta, large idiosyncratic).

evidence.note: Jio Credit AUM >Rs 30,000 cr in Q1 FY27; Payments Bank operational turnaround (Fortune India)

exposures.mechanism: P/E 92 and ROE 1.2%: stock is a long-duration growth asset. A +25bp yield raises discount rate on cash flows 10+ years out: duration ~20 -> -5% on terminal value share ~60% -> ~-3 net after partial offset from lender spread.

No retail deposit base; wholesale/bank funded (interest Rs 578 cr in Q2, ~Rs 2.3k cr annualised, ~Rs 30k cr debt). +25bp repo -> ~+Rs 60 cr funding cost on floating bank lines vs operating profit ~Rs 4.3k cr annualised = -1.4% EBITDA; plus yield pass-through partial; persistence 0.5 -> ~-0.7; combined with growth drag -> -1.5.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 340 cr (-51% y/y); NII +165%; total expenses Rs 1,166 cr (Economic Times/Upstox/Reuters)

exposures.mechanism: AAA/NBFC spreads widen +50bp: on ~Rs30k cr debt = Rs150 cr = ~3.5% of annualised operating profit, but also slows disbursal growth; multiple-weighted -3. Q3 FY26 interest cost jump (Rs 212 cr -> 578 cr in 5 quarters) shows funding is the swing item.
Book is mortgage/LAP, loans against securities and digital personal credit (model knowledge); AUM seasoning small so +1pp delinquency affects <1% of equity value but sentiment-sensitive.

JioBlackRock AMC (regular plans since 17 Aug 2026), broking (to launch with BlackRock), wealth: +20% traded value/demat additions lifts fee pools; currently small in P&L so option value dominates; ~+1.8.

evidence.note: JioBlackRock opens regular plans, steps up distributor push (Moneycontrol)

exposures.mechanism: Core investment case: household financialisation (MF, insurance, payments) is what the 'financial supermarket' monetises; stock trades at P/B 1.16 but P/E 92, i.e. paying for the optionality.
Jio Payments Solutions/Payments Bank (operational turnaround, Fortune India 26 Aug); UPI economics are weak so effect small.

evidence.note: Jio Credit AUM >Rs 30,000 cr in Q1 FY27; Payments Bank operational turnaround (Fortune India)

exposures.mechanism: NBFC-ND-SI with core-investment-company structure; risk-weight/leverage or digital-lending rule changes slow the build-out of lending.
Insurance JV with Allianz and broking subsidiary subject to IRDAI; launch timing sensitive to tightening; minor.
Market beta 1.5 per pack; FIIs fell 11.27% -> 10.00% (Jun -> Oct 2026); +US$5bn/qtr inflows add ~2.5% beyond beta because stock is a large-cap growth name in the Nifty 50.
+5 VIX points ~ Nifty -3.5%; beta 1.47-1.57 (pack) plus long-duration valuation -> -5.
DIIs hold 12.7-13.3%; index weight means SIP inflows buy mechanically; +10% flow ~ +2.

company_links.mechanism: Per +10% move in RELIANCE equity value: promoter group holds ~51%; Jio Platforms IPO sentiment (Oct 2026) and brand-group flows move both; beta of JIOFIN to RELIANCE ~0.3-0.4 in sentiment episodes -> +2.0 per +10% (assumed unit: % equity of dst per +10% equity of src).

evidence.note: Jio Platforms IPO (~$3.8bn, ~$143-146bn valuation) launched 22 Oct; JIOFIN -1% on 28 Oct (Livemint/Reuters)

Q3 FY27 results (mid-Jan 2027 est.; Q2 was 15 Oct 2026)

current_state.trend: Income >2x y/y (Sales Rs 1,699 cr vs 981 cr) and NII +165%, but PAT Rs 340 cr (-51% y/y vs one-off Q2 FY26 gain); Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 830 cr; interest cost Rs 578 cr vs 136 cr a year ago
current_state.valuation: P/E 92 TTM, P/B 1.16, ROE 1.2% - priced for the build-out, not for current earnings; MOFSL target Rs 300 (37% upside) after cutting FY27 EPS
recent_developments: 2026-08-12: BofA to buy up to 49.9% of Jio Credit (Rs 18,268 cr); stock +3%
2026-08-17: JioBlackRock opens regular mutual fund plans
2026-09-09: targets 100m customers; stock broking launch with BlackRock soon (CNBC TV18/LinkedIn)
2026-10-15: Q2 PAT -51% y/y; MOFSL cuts FY27 estimates (Business Standard)
2026-10-30: 25 crore shares allotted, promoter holding to ~51%

key_risks: Funding cost and spread widening on a wholesale-funded balance sheet
Execution/credit seasoning of fast-growing unsecured and digital books
Overhang/competition for retail flows from Jio Platforms IPO
RBI regulation of NBFCs and CIC structure
Related-party/brand dependence on Reliance Jio ecosystem
upside_triggers: BofA deal closing validating Jio Credit valuation
Rapid AUM scale-up with stable credit cost
Index and passive inflows plus FPI return
